{{Quote|Did you recover Skywalker's records?''"<br />"''Yes. With all the Jedi in the jungle it was almost too easy.|Tavion Axmis and Alora|<ref name="Academy" />}}
The '''Yavin 4 Incursion''' took place in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] when the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] infiltrated [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in attempt to [[Force drain/Legends|drain]] Force energy from one of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] temples and steal data from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] records.

==Prelude==
A group of Disciples of Ragnos, led by [[Tavion Axmis]], landed in the jungle on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Among the group were also the [[Kothos twins]]. Their objective was to drain Force energy from a Massassi temple and store it into the [[Scepter of Ragnos]].<ref name="Academy" />

==The battle==
[[File:AwkwardSlicingTechnique-JA.png|thumb|left|200px|Alora slicing into Skywalker's personal records]]
About the same time, the ''[[Yavin Runner II]]'' was arriving from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with new Jedi students on board. Among these students were [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Rosh Penin]]. Axmis seized the opportunity and shot down the ''Yavin Runner II'' which crashed several kilometers west of the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]]. Luke Skywalker then dispatched a shuttle and a rescue team of Jedi to pick them up. This served as a perfect diversion for Axmis's second objective. In the meantime, [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], Axmis's apprentice, snuck into the Academy, [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into Skywalker's personal records and stole data from it.<ref name="Academy" />

During the crash, Korr and Penin were separated from the rest of the survivors and were instructed to make their way to the [[Unidentified Massassi temple|temple]]. On their way they had to fight a few [[Howler (Yavin 4)|howlers]]. When they arrived at the temple they spotted two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. After Korr defeated them he was attacked by a Sith cultist whom he also defeated. He then approached the temple and interrupted Axmis while she was draining Force energy from the temple and she knocked him unconscious. By the time he was woken up by [[Kyle Katarn]], the Disciples of Ragnos were already gone with their mission complete.<ref name="Academy" />
